observed: Executable local simulator/test runs when separately receipted

modelTariffs.verification: Reopened official model, pricing, latest-model, reasoning, billing, and Terra announcement pages. No model API call, access purchase, or subscription entitlement inference.

models.access_route: Responses API; API usage billed separately from ChatGPT subscription
models.role_suitability: Officially described for demanding reasoning, coding, computer use, research and document creation; this does not calibrate algorithm invention or customer acceptance.

models.access_route: Responses API for tools; API usage billed separately from ChatGPT subscription
models.role_suitability: Officially described for visual reasoning, computer use and writing; visual/execution role selected where supported, with no assumed generic expertise gain.

billing_rules.pro: Aggregates internal model work at selected model standard token rates; no fixed Pro multiplier.
billing_rules.reasoning: Included in billed output; do not add twice.
billing_rules.input_partition: Ordinary input equals total minus cache reads and writes; write tariff replaces ordinary input tariff.
billing_rules.long_context: More than 272000 input tokens in one request: 2x input/cache and 1.5x output for the whole request.
billing_rules.short_request_assumption: New workflow explicitly splits aggregate role work into requests of at most 200000 input and 128000 output tokens. This is a modeled orchestration choice, not an observed trace.
billing_rules.subscription: ChatGPT subscription and API billing are separate. No subscription-funded unlimited production is assumed.

tools.container_note: The current page also states eligible sessions can bill per minute with a five-minute minimum. Conservative 20-minute blocks may be assumed explicitly; do not silently assert all sessions qualify.
tools.cpu_solver_price: Separate external compute calibration required; CPU-hours are not inferred from API container memory-session prices.

modelTariffs.changes_from_same_day_prior_check: The model and tool price numbers are unchanged. The new record explicitly notes the eligible per-minute container billing clause.
modelTariffs.capacity: Concurrency, token throughput, deadlines and quotas remain model assumptions; official model support is not evidence of account-specific allowance.
modelTariffs.performance_transfer: No vendor evaluation score is converted to customer acceptance, correctness, buyer demand, or invention probability.

roleBudgets.interpretation: Full billed internal Pro work and reasoning output are included, not multiplied by an arbitrary expertise factor.

jobClasses.name: Executable scheduling or batching policy with held-out evaluation
Coupled planning policy with linked constraint families

A_B_C.A: All resource work producing the accepted customer artifact, including learning/search/correction. A stays in job and consolidated expense.
A_B_C.B: Only additional retention, rights/sanitization, generalization, fresh paired assessment, distribution, integration, revalidation and upkeep. No source-job A is recharged.
A_B_C.C: Optional separate research beyond the paid scope. Its complete additional cost is retained in the investment and Alpha hurdle when chosen.
A_B_C.valuationsAreNotExpenses: Probe counterfactual utility and source-job references do not create duplicate cash bills. Reserves are unavailable cash, not expenses. Customer savings are not revenue.

strategicLimits: Buyer private value, trust, recurrence, human completion and contingent billing are unmeasured.
Skill emergence and transfer effects are hypotheses, not field-estimated frequencies.
Alpha intervals reflect conditional simulation noise and do not bound shared semantic bias.
Physical deployment, professional signoff and unsupported semantics are outside the automated contract.
Access restriction is not proof of scarcity or a durable economic moat.
